source_classification.source_derived: Statements reproduced or conservatively constrained from the cited sources without adding a clinical threshold, without converting evidence grades into probabilities, and without converting a scale total or percent change into a no-improvement probability.
source_classification.proposed_for_review: Agent-proposed graph, states, transforms, baseline and measure windows, horizons, wording, and reference values; not source-derived clinical rules.

question_enumeration.specific_question: For an adult follow-up encounter during current clozapine treatment with a linked current baseline, a complete baseline and follow-up PANSS pair with recorded instruments and dates, a recorded trial-adequacy category, a recorded residual-symptom judgment, an exposure-interpretation context, and an urgent assessment, what is the posterior distribution over persistent-symptom review prompts (continue periodic review vs review trial adequacy vs specialist persistent-symptoms review, with outside-scope estimated for completeness), with a parallel exposure review, to structure physician review?
question_enumeration.intended_setting: Adult outpatient follow-up for schizophrenia during ongoing clozapine treatment; current dated encounter with a chosen signed baseline. Not the emergency department. Local setting confirmation requested.
question_enumeration.proposed_time_horizon: Current encounter (no outcome prediction horizon). The baseline-to-current interval is recorded and displayed; no maximum recency interval is imposed in v0.1.

output_meanings.continue_periodic_review: Review prompt: no current clinically significant residual symptoms on clozapine are recorded with an adequate-trial context and a linked baseline. Continue periodic review with repeated validated measures. Not an improvement certification and not a safety clearance.
output_meanings.review_trial_adequacy: Review prompt: residual symptoms are recorded but the trial is recorded as not adequate, or exposure interpretation is uncertain. Review exposure, adherence evidence, interacting factors, sampling validity, and duration before labeling nonresponse. Never a no-improvement label from an inadequate trial or a missing score.
output_meanings.specialist_persistent_symptoms_review: Review prompt: persistent clinically significant residual symptoms on clozapine are recorded despite a recorded adequate trial with a linked baseline and a complete pair. Arrange specialist review of psychosocial care and augmentation options per Statement 7 optimizing-treatment discussion. No automatic ECT, polypharmacy, or discontinuation.
output_meanings.outside_current_treatment_scope: Contract-completeness branch only: estimated for all CPT rows but never reached when the gate holds (non-current status yields not_applicable without inference). Not an improvement finding and not a resistance finding.
output_meanings.triggered: Parallel prompt: exposure interpretation concern is recorded during current treatment; review adherence, interacting factors, and sampling validity.
output_meanings.not_triggered: Parallel prompt: no exposure interpretation concern is recorded; continue routine exposure surveillance with disclosure of any unknown context.

question_enumeration.applicability: Follow-up encounters only (encounter.kind == followup) with current clozapine treatment, a linked current baseline with confirmed reconciliation, and a complete baseline and follow-up PANSS pair. Non-current status or a registration encounter yields not_applicable with reason; outdated, unreconciled, unknown, missing, partial, not_assessed, or conflicting baseline or measure yields needs_clarification stopping later questions.

source_comparison.bn07_scope_vs_f5: BN-07 is a 23-node combined registration and ongoing-treatment draft with inference_allowed=false and deployment_allowed=false. F5 keeps only its 7 ongoing-treatment nodes (5 clinician inputs plus 2 review outputs) with states and GIVEN edges retained verbatim, and defers the 16 registration-scope nodes to R7. The two BN-07 deterministic 0/1 tables for the retained outputs were replaced with soft argmax-preserving synthetic placeholders; no BN-07 TABLE bytes, priors, or inference/deployment flags were copied.
source_comparison.r7_vs_f5_separation: R7 (EstablishedCaseClozapine_R7_draft, 18 nodes, registration gate with established status and two prior trials) and F5 (NoImprovementClozapine_F5_draft, 7 nodes, follow-up gate with current treatment, linked baseline, and complete PANSS pair) share BN-07 as a drafting lead and share ClozapineTreatmentStatus and UrgentSafetyConcern concepts, but have distinct question keys, network names, node sets, edge sets, gates, prompts, and templates. No file is shared between the packages except the cited source hashes. A first-time or non-current case never receives an F5 posterior; a follow-up without a linked baseline never receives an R7 posterior.
source_comparison.guideline_gives_no_cutoff: STATEMENT-07 states a 1B clozapine recommendation for treatment-resistant schizophrenia and describes TRRIP background (12 weeks, moderate severity with moderate impairment, 20 percent improvement as additional evidence, two 6-week therapeutic trials with 80 percent adherence) plus optimizing-treatment background (adequate exposure with at least 8 weeks; typically 300-450 mg/day and greater than 350 ng/mL; longitudinal quantitative measure helpful). None of these is encoded as a gate, threshold, stored regimen number, or probability. The 20 percent and 8-week points are background references in definitions only. Dose, level, unit, route, and frequency are excluded by FR-14 redesign.
source_comparison.panss_reuse: PANSS.md 30-item 1-7 arithmetic, previous-7-days window, and the (baseline minus follow-up) divided by baseline times 100 formula shape are reproduced as supporting context only. The denominator (baseline total) and zero-case note are recorded because plan section 5 requires them for any future change formula, but v0.1 computes no change value and applies no cutoff. Approximate total-score anchors are explicitly not thresholds. A missing follow-up total is never no improvement. Baseline totals are read from frozen signed snapshots, never recomputed and never as newly completed answers.
source_comparison.history_baseline_reuse: Follow-up baseline mechanics (chosen signed baseline_encounter_id, verbatim history and medication copy with restamped provenance, pending reconciliation until confirmed, baseline_changed indicator on newer signed records, prior scores as historical) are reused as the baseline-linkage gate. Page notes are excluded from every mapping. No new regimen field is added.

graph_decision.why_this_shape: Two parallel review outputs over the ongoing-treatment inputs, mirroring BN-07's exposure and persistent-symptom structure at an executable size (71 cells). Baseline linkage and PANSS-pair completeness gate execution as estimation context (cpt_context only, like R7 ClinicalStatusGate) rather than as network parents, so the network conditions on the current-trial inputs while the gate enforces the linked-baseline and complete-measure requirements. Registration indication, TRS flagging, willingness, monitoring, and medical-review nodes are excluded as R7 scope; augmentation product choice and dosing are excluded entirely. All discrete nature nodes for the v1 execution profile; no latent nodes, no posterior chaining into other questions.
graph_decision.double_counting_rationale_for_review: Each assessed network input is proposed as usage=both (CPT-estimation context + hard observation). Rationale for review: conditioning once in Bayes rule is a single update, not double counting; the LLM conditions table estimates on the patient's context while inference instantiates the same observed states as evidence. Optional missing exposure uses estimation context only (the gap is noted in the conditioning context) with no hard evidence, so no update occurs on an unobserved node. Baseline and PANSS-pair applicability inputs are usage=cpt_context only (they gate execution and condition estimation but are never network nodes, so no observation exists). Owner to accept or restrict any mapping to observation-only.

unresolved_assumptions: The baseline-linkage, PANSS-pair, trial-adequacy, residual, exposure, and urgent fields are proposals; the history-effects package itself is still awaiting_review and the clozapine_followup namespace is not collected, so no mapping used here is approved.
No maximum baseline recency interval is imposed; the interval is recorded for physician interpretation and any future cutoff needs review.
No percent-change value is computed and no cutoff is applied; the denominator and zero-case note exists only to satisfy the plan section 5 requirement for any future formula.

Adequate-tolerated-exposure and residual-symptom judgments rely on clinician-recorded agents, dates, response, adherence evidence, domains, and scale versions; the locally intended evidence requirements for adequate, partial, and uncertain remain unresolved.
Exposure concern as the sole optional input with disclosure needs review; all other missing required inputs block.
Reference tables are synthetic placeholders with zero clinical validity.
